milestone: MARPOL Annex VI amendments establishing the Net-Zero Framework formally adopted by IMO parties
coding_notes: Malignant: fuel-cost and distributional conflict, US and Saudi opposition. No veto: adoption by two-thirds of parties present and voting (rule not verified here). Capacity: established IMO secretariat and MEPC process. Low uncertainty: emissions accounting well defined. Vote date reported variously as Oct or 4 Dec 2026.

milestone: Treaty text adopted by a diplomatic conference or INC session
coding_notes: Malignant: producer states vs high-ambition coalition, production caps contested. Veto: consensus insisted on by a group of states; voting not yet used for substance. Capacity: chair resigned Oct 2025, new chair Feb 2026. Low uncertainty: harm well documented.

milestone: PABS annex adopted by the World Health Assembly (regular or special session)
coding_notes: Malignant: benefit-sharing conflict between pathogen-providing countries and manufacturers. Veto: working group operates by consensus in practice. Capacity: WHO secretariat. High uncertainty: value and terms of benefits contested. Deadline extended May 2026.

milestone: Exploitation regulations (mining code) adopted by the ISA Council
coding_notes: Malignant: sponsoring states vs moratorium states; US unilateral licensing outside ISA. Veto: consensus sought. Capacity: ISA secretariat and LTC. High uncertainty: deep-sea ecosystem impacts.

milestone: First area-based management tool (e.g. marine protected area) established by the BBNJ Conference of the Parties
coding_notes: Partly malignant: fishing and shipping interests. No veto: voting allowed if consensus fails (provision not verified here). Capacity: new secretariat, first COP due within a year of entry into force (Jan 2026). Low uncertainty: MPA science established.
